sentences.text: 4. The counsel for the appellant prayed for condonation of delay.
The delay in filing the present appeal is neither intentional nor deliberate.

5. The respective counsel for the respondents stated that the court may pass suitable orders regarding the condonation of delay but the appellant is not entitled to claim interest for the said period.
6. After considering all facts, the application is allowed and the delay of 690 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.
However, it is made clear that the appellant shall not be entitled to claim the interest for the period of delay in filing the present appeal.
7. The application stands disposed of.

8. The present appeal is filed under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to impugn the order dated 04.04.2022 passed by the court of Sh.
